cases.name: Morya Noreen Gularte
cases.about: Her obituary said, "She was a respected and successful businesswoman. Working for the family business, Hildebrand & Sons Trucking, started by her parents James and Dorothea Hildebrand in 1942. Morya was a member of Gabilan Cutters, and an avid supporter for a variety of organizations dedicated to the love and well-being of animals. Her greatest joys were being with her family, traveling the world, breeding and raising horses, and camping with her family at Pismo Beach. She loved to care for her horses, dogs, and cats on her late husband’s ranch. Above all else she was a wealth of information and inspiration to her children, grandchildren, and great-grandchildren, always ensuring their success and happiness."
